name: 白披风骑士猫的独白

roles.name: 白披风骑士猫
roles.voice: young female, soft sweet voice, mid register, light nasal warmth, slow and clear, warm and clingy

look: 写实奇幻风格，柔和暖色调，细腻毛发与金属质感，浅景深，人物居中的电影感构图。
setting: 午后柔和的自然光从画面一侧斜照进来，混着暖色的环境补光，画面整体明亮温暖。角色1站在画面中间，面向镜头说话。
constraints: 全片一个生成片段，机位固定，角色1始终居中面向镜头，姿态不挪位。角色1按顺序说出三句台词，每句独立成拍，句间留短暂停顿，语气从平静的自述转为温柔恳求。剑是全场唯一的一把，全程属于握着剑的那只前爪：先竖直持在身侧，再缓缓放低到腿边，剑尖朝下。另一只空手在第三句台词之前抬起，掌心朝上伸向镜头，最后保持这个摊开的掌心姿势。画面中只有角色1一个角色，环境中任何可见文字都是中文。
source_script:
角色1：拿着剑，我就没法拥抱你。
角色1动作：他把剑缓缓放低，剑尖朝下贴到腿边。
角色1：放下剑，我就没法保护你。
角色1动作：他抬起空着的那只手，掌心朝上伸向镜头。
角色1：所以，你为什么不主动抱过来呢？
角色1动作：说完他保持摊开的掌心，目光温柔地看向镜头。

events.text: 拿着剑，我就没法拥抱你。
他把剑缓缓放低，剑尖朝下贴到腿边。
放下剑，我就没法保护你。
他抬起空着的那只手，掌心朝上伸向镜头。
所以，你为什么不主动抱过来呢？
说完他保持摊开的掌心，目光温柔地看向镜头。

execution.look: A photorealistic fantasy style with a soft warm palette, fine fur and metal textures, shallow depth of field, and a cinematic composition with the character in the center.
execution.setting: Soft afternoon daylight falls in from one side of the frame together with warm ambient fill, keeping the whole image bright and warm. Character 1 stands in the middle of frame facing the camera and speaks.
execution.visible_state: Soft afternoon daylight comes from one side together with warm ambient fill, keeping the frame bright and warm. Character 1 stands in the middle of frame facing the camera, holding the only sword in the scene upright in one paw, the other paw resting at the side, with a calm and steady expression.

voices.character_1: young female, soft sweet voice, mid register, light nasal warmth, slow and clear, warm and clingy

directions.event_002: Character 1 lowers the only sword in the scene in one paw until the blade points down beside the leg, while the other paw stays resting at the side.
directions.event_004: Character 1 raises the free paw with the palm turned upward toward the camera in an open inviting palm, while the sword paw keeps the lowered sword.
directions.event_006: Character 1 holds the open palm toward the camera and looks at the camera with a gentle, slightly wistful gaze, the sword staying lowered in the other paw.
